name: Qucusaurus
description:
When played: Attach Target to the opposing active character.
When an opposing character with Target attached switches to become the active character: You gain 1 stack of Efficient Switch and Agile Switch, and then cancel all Target attached to opposing characters.
Technique: Swift Glide
Usage(s): 2
(A character can only equip 1 Technique at a time)
